decodes_to: MCC 268, MNC 3, colour code 32, location area 4658
notes: The second of the pair, and a different cell: colour code 32 against tetra_cc17.bin's 17, location area 4658 against 4375.

The tuning is 392.8735 rather than a round number on purpose. A first attempt recorded at 392.84 put the carrier 33.5 kHz away, which is more than a channel spacing and outside what a coarse search should reach for -- the estimator pinned itself at the edge of its range and half the blocks failed. Tuned to the carrier the offset is under 200 Hz and every block decodes.
That is worth knowing before recording another: TETRA channels are 25 kHz apart, so a coarse search wide enough to cover a large tuning error is also wide enough to select the neighbouring channel.
